why_this_corpus: frozen polyglot fixture tree: committed, offline, and its digest moves only on a deliberate fixture change, so a baseline stays comparable across releases. crates/codingest/src is the code under test and its digest moves nearly every release, which would make the gate REFUSE every time.
stored_value: min of 3 runs per query (repeatable inner loop); build_secs is the mean of 3 runs (once-per-build cost has no floor to find)
build_gating: recorded, not enforced: at 46 KB the build is dominated by one-time grammar init. Node/edge counts carry the build-side signal and are deterministic here (zero spread across three runs in both modes).
stability_across_3_runs: worst per-query median spread was 0.001 ms docs-on (top20_by_branch_count) and 0.003 ms docs-off (defs_per_file), across three post-warmup runs per mode -- one and three 1 microsecond quantization ticks. Node and edge counts were identical in all runs (567/880 docs-on, 560/859 docs-off), unchanged from the 0.2.25 record across the kglite 0.17.10 -> 0.18.0 engine move, and every cross-build parity flag held. build_secs means were 0.0118 s docs-on from per-run 0.012/0.012/0.0115 and 0.0100 s docs-off from 0.010/0.010/0.010. FLOORS HELD AT 0.0075 IN BOTH MODES, as 0.2.20 through 0.2.25 did: 2.5x the worst three-tick spread is exactly 0.0075. varlen_callers_1_3 remains the control: stored at 0.028 ms in both modes, 3.73x the floor, over the 2x minimum, and flat versus the 0.2.25 record (0.028/0.029) across this engine move -- codingest's only source change is the opt-in methodology recipe writer, which the bench never reaches.
